units.source_text: “自然的，拔死人的头发，真不知道是怎样的恶事呵。

en.t: Of course, pulling hair from the dead is an evil thing, though I truly cannot say how evil.

units.source_text: 只是，在这里的这些死人，都是，便给这么办，也是活该的人们。

en.t: But all these dead people here are people who deserved to have such things done to them.

units.source_text: 现在，我刚才，拔着那头发的女人，是将蛇切成四寸长，晒干了，说是干鱼，到带刀的营里去出卖的。

en.t: Just now, the woman whose hair I was pulling used to cut snakes into four-inch pieces, dry them, call them dried fish, and sell them at the camp of the armed men.

units.source_text: 倘使没有遭瘟，现在怕还卖去罢。

en.t: If she had not caught the plague, she would probably still be going out to sell them now.

units.source_text: 这人也是的，这女人去卖的干鱼，说是口味好，带刀们当作缺不得的菜料买。

en.t: This person was the same: the dried fish that woman sold was said to taste good, and the armed men bought it as an indispensable side dish.

units.source_text: 我呢，并不觉得这女人做的事是恶的。

en.t: As for me, I do not think what this woman did was evil.

units.source_text: 不做，便要饿死，没法子才做的罢。

en.t: If she had not done it, she would have starved, so she did it because she had no choice.

units.source_text: 那就，我做的事，也不觉得是恶事。

en.t: In that case, I do not think what I am doing is evil either.

units.source_text: 这也是，不做便要饿死，没法子才做的呵。

en.t: This too is something I do because, if I do not, I will starve and have no other way.

units.source_text: 很明白这没法子的事的这女人，料来也应该宽恕我的。”

en.t: This woman, who understands very well what it means to have no choice, should surely forgive me too.
